facts.text: MimicWalker3dEnv is a concrete subclass of MimicEnv
MimicEnv is a subclass of gym's MujocoEnv and EzPickle

MimicWalker3dEnv implements the base class hooks: COM indices [0, 1, 2], trunk rotation indices [3, 4, 5], the not-actuated joints [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5], and maximum actuator velocities [5, 1, 10, 10, 5, 1, 10, 10]

The constructor reads the model file name from config_light.WALKER_MJC_XML_FILE, builds the mocap reference trajectories, joins the name below assets/, and calls MimicEnv.__init__ with the XML path and the reference object
The configured model file name is walker3d_flat_feet_lowmass.xml
The reference trajectories are loaded from a hard-coded absolute assets path: /home/rustam/code/remote/ on remote machines and /mnt/88E4BD3EE4BD2EF6/... elsewhere; data paths are built from that root
MimicWalker3d-v0 is registered with entry point gym_mimic_envs.mujoco:MimicWalker3dEnv
The gym_mimic_envs.mujoco package initializer imports MimicWalker2dEnv from mimic_walker2d, so importing the package entry point executes that import first

MimicEnv builds the simulation with MujocoEnv.__init__(xml_path, frame_skip), then sets the model timestep to 1 / SIM_FREQ and control_freq = SIM_FREQ / frame_skip, syncs the reference trajectories to that control frequency and overwrites actuator_forcerange with the configured torque ranges
The simulation runs at SIM_FREQ = 1000 Hz and the control loop at CTRL_FREQ = 200 Hz
The configured peak joint torques are [50, 50, 50, 5] for hip_sag, hip_front, knee and ankle
get_torque_ranges repeats its four peak arguments for both sides into an 8 by 2 range
frame_skip is SIM_FREQ / CTRL_FREQ and must be an integer
The MJCF model uses the RK4 integrator with timestep 0.001 s and defines the default motor ctrlrange as -300 to 300
The actuator list has eight motors: hip sagittal, hip frontal, knee and ankle, right then left

MimicEnv.step rescales the action, mirrors it in a mirroring mode, calls do_simulation(action, frame_skip), advances the reference trajectories, builds the observation, computes the imitation reward, evaluates the terminal condition and returns (observation, reward, done, {})
In torque mode rescale_actions clips every policy action to [-1, 1] and scales it by PEAK_JOINT_TORQUES * 2
The constant-speed mocap dataset contains 35 steps of walking at 1.5 m/s sampled at 400 Hz
The observation is [phase, desired walking speed] + qpos[1:] + qvel; the 3D layout runs from index 0 (phase) and 1 (desired velocity) through 28 (left ankle velocity)
The imitation reward uses weights from config.rew_weights for a sum of pose, velocity, COM and power rewards, or sqrt(pose) * sqrt(COM) in MOD_REW_MULT, and multiplies by rew_scale
The reward weights string is '8200' outside MOD_FLY and '7300' in MOD_FLY; rew_scale is 1 and the alive bonus is 0.2 * rew_scale

The episode ends when the COM height is below 0.5, the episode duration reaches cfg.ep_dur_max or the walked distance exceeds cfg.max_distance + 0.01; outside evaluation it also ends on early termination
The configured maximum episode length is 3000 steps and the maximum walking distance is 10

Early termination thresholds are COM height below 0.75, sagittal trunk angle above 0.3 or below -0.05, frontal deviation above 0.2, axial deviation above 0.5 and absolute lateral COM position above 0.2; MOD_FLY disables the COM-height condition

reset_model calls get_init_state, applies qpos/qvel, subtracts the lowest foot-site z from COM z, checks reward > 0.95 * rew_scale outside MOD_FLY, advances the reference trajectories and returns the observation
README.md names mimic_walker3d.py as the main environment used to train walking policies and walker3d_flat_feet.xml as the model that defines the morphology and inertial properties

determinism.notes: the fake draws its initial phase with Python's random.Random(seed) and every later transition is a deterministic analytic update, so a fresh fake world repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream class was not constructed or compared, so this claim is about the deployed fake only

gaps: the fake is an analytic, phase-driven stand-in, not MuJoCo: it models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors or noise; one tick is the 5 ms control period (SIM_FREQ 1000 Hz / CTRL_FREQ 200 Hz) and the action only perturbs a synthetic reference gait

the upstream environment cannot be constructed at the pinned commit: the gym_mimic_envs.mujoco initializer imports mimic_walker2d (mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mujoco/__init__.py:1), that file is absent; the configured walker3d_flat_feet_lowmass.xml (scripts/config_light.py:28) is absent from the assets directory, which contains walker3d_flat_feet.xml; and the reference loader uses hard-coded absolute paths outside the clone (scripts/mocap/ref_trajecs.py:26-35)

the fake's [-300, 300] action envelope is placeholder data borrowed from the available XML; the configured lowmass XML is absent, so no upstream action-space provenance is claimed; MimicEnv clips policy actions to [-1, 1] in torque mode (mujoco/gym_mimic_envs/mimic_env.py:161), as the fake does

the reward is an analytic imitation-like stand-in using the configured weights and alive bonus; it is not the upstream reference-trajectory reward and no trajectory was compared with a real MuJoCo run
the fake uses a constant 1.5 m/s desired speed instead of the configured ramp trajectories; its zero-reference termination deviations and terminal rewards are placeholders
the fake exposes legacy reset() plus seed(seed); the bridge's keyword reset falls back to these; reset options are ignored, and the upstream inherited Gym implementation is outside the clone
the observation space is unbounded and 29 values wide, matching the class layout; the fake returns Python floats and lists where the upstream returns numpy arrays
no rendering, no snapshot or restore (the upstream class exposes no get_state/set_state pair) and no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor is 0 and only commands advance the world
the upstream dependency set is gym, mujoco-py and MuJoCo 2.1, none of which is installed where the gate runs; package code never imports the clone
